title: The Life of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)
description: The seerah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) - from his birth and early years, through the revelation, the persecution of Makkah, the Hijrah to Madinah, the great battles, the Conquest of Makkah, and his death. A series of lessons from Forgotten Light, a Salafi lecture channel.
short_description: The complete seerah of the Prophet (PBUH)

modules.title: The Early Years
modules.description: The world before the Prophet, his birth and his youth.

lessons.title: Prophet Muhammad A Mercy To Mankind — Abu Idrees
lessons.content: The Prophet as a mercy to the worlds: his character and the universal message he brought. source: Forgotten Light (https://www.youtube.com/@FgnLight) - Salafi lectures by Abu Khadeejah, Abu Idrees, Abu Hakeem and Hasan Somali

lessons.title: The World That the Prophet was Born Into and His Early Years

lessons.title: Character of the Prophet Muhammad — Abu Khadeejah
lessons.content: The noble character of the Prophet (peace be upon him) as described in the Qur'an and the hadith. source: Forgotten Light (https://www.youtube.com/@FgnLight) - Salafi lectures by Abu Khadeejah, Abu Idrees, Abu Hakeem and Hasan Somali

lessons.title: How The Prophet Treated Children — Abu Khadeejah
lessons.content: The Prophet's gentleness and affection towards children, with examples from his life. source: Forgotten Light (https://www.youtube.com/@FgnLight) - Salafi lectures by Abu Khadeejah, Abu Idrees, Abu Hakeem and Hasan Somali

modules.title: Revelation, Hardship & Hijrah
